_comment: The orchestrator's PUBLISHED human action surface, pinned for the cross-repo parity gate (crates/console-cli/tests/drive_surface_parity.rs). Source of truth: livespec-orchestrator-beads-fabro SPECIFICATION/contracts.md § '#### drive' (the action-id grammar) and § 'Per-state operator verb vocabulary', cross-checked against the shipped is_human_valve_action prefix tuple (_drive_valves.py:92-107, plugin c402de396ee3). There is no machine-readable upstream manifest for actions (only config keys have one), so this fixture is a hand-reviewed capture: refresh it by re-reading those sections and re-recording each divergence below with a reason. Every entry MUST carry either a console_binding (a registry action id) or a mandatory non-empty omission reason — an allowlist says 'ignore this'; a reason says 'here is why'.

actions.note: The console's move-status valve routes a blocked item's move through the semantic resolve-blocked action id (move_status_outcome).

SHIPPED BUT UNPUBLISHED upstream: absent from contracts.md's 'ten human valve/policy actions' list while present in the shipped prefix tuple. The valve is the documented remedy a factory-safety refusal names (-w7d); this gate was BORN RED against it before the console bound it.

published_but_unimplemented.reason: Published at contracts.md '#### driver-dispatch:<id>' but absent from the shipped drive surface (no handler in the scripts tree). The console's driver-handoff overlay covers the operator half; binding a drive action that does not exist would be a phantom.
Named in contracts.md prose but absent from the shipped drive surface. Not bindable until it exists.

non_operator_actions.reason: Per-item dispatch stays PARKED per plan/archive/command-queue-semantics/ (-8aw): the queue-level palette drain is the MVP dispatch surface. Not a human valve upstream (dispatcher shell-out).
Read surface consumed by the Settings view via the config manifest completeness gate (console-completeness-check), not a per-item operator action.
Machine manifest read; consumed by just refresh-config-manifest, not an operator action.
Bound through the Settings view's row editor (ConfigDispatcherSettingSet), which the config completeness gate already binds to docs; outside the per-item registry.

console_local_actions.reason: Console-side verb: renders the driver invocation for copy/paste; the driver session journals its own dispatch through the orchestrator's driver-dispatch surface. Not a drive action-id.
